attributes.headline: Dashboard Access FAQ
attributes.body:
**Why can I see the dashboard but no data?**
Your account has view access but has not been added to a workspace yet. Your administrator can add you.

**Why did the dashboard stop loading after I changed browsers?**
The session is tied to the browser. Sign in again on the new one.

**Can I share a dashboard link?**
Yes, but the person opening it needs access to the same workspace.
